title: Настя открывает глаза Максу  (Nastya Opens Max's Eyes)

segments.t: Unable to hold back any longer, Nastya approaches Max at the bar and tells him she suspects her Kostya is cheating on her with Sasha. Max dismisses it as nonsense until Nastya leads him to the corridor, where he overhears Kostya pressuring Sasha to confess.
Мой Костик изменяет меня с твоей Сашей.
Я не могу врать своему лучшему другу.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Maxim, listen to me.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Maxim' and finishing on 'listen'. Kostya answers right away.
'That is exactly what I am talking about.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'both' and 'I' in a few short words.
'In fact, it seems to me that...' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'for me' and 'at all' in a few short words.
Мой Костик изменяет меня с твоей Сашей.
'My Kostik is cheating on me with your Sasha.' Notice how Russian expresses 'my' and 'Sasha' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'That is nonsense, it cannot be true.' In Russian, the idea of 'yes' flows naturally into 'maybe' without extra filler words.
'They were holding hands.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to hold on' before landing on 'hands'.
'Well, let us go see.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'let's go'. Kostya answers right away.
'That is not what we agreed on.' The meaning hinges on 'we' working together with 'had an agreement' in spoken Russian.
'You promised to tell him yourself.' Sasha anchors the line on 'you', while 'to tell' completes the thought.
'Will that make you feel any better?' The grammar packs 'by' and 'will become' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Kostya answers right away.
Я не могу врать своему лучшему другу.
'I cannot keep lying to my best friend.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'other' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Either you tell him right now.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'or' and 'you' in a few short words.
'So you really cheated on me?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'so' and finishing on 'would change'. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Мой Костик изменяет меня с твоей Сашей.
